answer: Seniority-weighted rewards: an identity's payout weight grows with the square root of its age in epochs, capped at 100. A lotus bloom of 1,000 fresh fakes earns like 10 old accounts, so attackers must anchor each clone for months, costing time that money cannot buy. Anyone can verify by reading join epochs from the public ledger and recomputing weights, even for a saffron-cheap swarm.
